# Custom MERV report (JavaScript & TypeScript)

Hand-built suites / testcases / steps **without** Playwright Test reporter or Cucumber formatter.

Uses **`merv-client` only** (core). You do **not** need `merv-client-playwright` or `merv-client-cucumber` for this path.

Website guide: [merv-local-custom-report.html](https://merv.online/merv-local-custom-report.html) (source: `merv-ui/public/website/`).

---

## When to use

- CLI scripts, batch jobs, or API checks outside a test runner
- Prototypes before adopting Playwright / Cucumber adapters
- Pipelines that already decide pass/fail but want MERV HTML or cloud storage

| Approach | Packages |
|----------|----------|
| **Custom (`MervReport`)** | `merv-client` |
| Playwright Test | `merv-client` + `merv-client-playwright` |
| Cucumber-js | `merv-client` + `merv-client-cucumber` (+ optional `merv-client-playwright` for UI actions) |

---

## Install

### Automated setup (`doctor`)

```bash
npm install merv-client
npx merv-client doctor setup
# TypeScript:
npx merv-client doctor setup --typescript
```

Creates / heals `merv.properties`, sample `scripts/custom-report.*`, and related scripts. Full reference: **[DOCTOR.md](./DOCTOR.md)**.

### Manual setup

#### JavaScript (ESM)

```bash
npm install merv-client
```

Then add `merv.properties` (below) and a script such as `scripts/custom-report.mjs` (JavaScript example).

#### TypeScript

```bash
npm install merv-client
npm install -D typescript tsx @types/node
```

Then add `merv.properties` and `scripts/custom-report.ts` (TypeScript example).

---

## `merv.properties`

Project root (directory you run from):

```properties
merv.local=true
merv.report.folder=./merv-reports/
merv.regression_suite=Custom Report Suite
```

Server mode:

```properties
merv.local=false
merv.server=https://merv.online/api/v1
merv.api_key=your-api-key
merv.regression_suite=Custom Report Suite
# merv.parent_hierarchy=optional-uuid
```

---

## JavaScript example

`scripts/custom-report.mjs`:

```js
import { MervReport, MervReportFile } from 'merv-client';

const report = await MervReport.open();

await report.createTest('Checkout API', 'POST /checkout with valid cart');
await report.info('Using staging tenant STG-42');
await report.testdata(
  'Request body',
  JSON.stringify({ cartId: 'cart-991', currency: 'USD' }),
);
// Optional — only if the file exists on disk:
await report.testdata('Payload file', new MervReportFile('./fixtures/checkout-payload.json'));
await report.validation('HTTP status', '200', '200');

await report.finalize();
console.log('Report written under merv.report.folder');
```

```bash
node scripts/custom-report.mjs
```

---

## TypeScript example

`scripts/custom-report.ts`:

```ts
import { MervReport, MervReportFile } from 'merv-client';

async function runCustomReport(): Promise<void> {
  const report = await MervReport.open();

  await report.createTest('Checkout API', 'POST /checkout with valid cart');
  await report.info('Using staging tenant STG-42');
  await report.testdata(
    'Request body',
    JSON.stringify({ cartId: 'cart-991', currency: 'USD' }),
  );
  await report.testdata(
    'Payload file',
    new MervReportFile('./fixtures/checkout-payload.json'),
  );
  await report.validation('HTTP status', '200', '200');

  await report.finalize();
}

runCustomReport().catch((err: unknown) => {
  console.error(err);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

```bash
npx tsx scripts/custom-report.ts
```

---

## API (both languages)

| Method | Role |
|--------|------|
| `await MervReport.open(opts?)` | Open local or server session from `merv.properties` |
| `await report.createTest(name, desc)` | Start a testcase |
| `await report.info(text)` | `PREREQUISITE` / info row |
| `await report.testdata(name, string \| MervReportFile)` | `TEST_DATA` |
| `await report.validation(name, expected, actual, screenshot?)` | `ASSERTION` (exact match); optional viewport PNG if a Playwright page is bound |
| `await report.finalize()` | Flush case; mark local run completed (final HTML + zip) or complete server suite |

Local mode writes **live** `merv-report.json` (and refreshes the index) after `open`, `createTest`, and each step — you do not need to wait for `finalize()` to open the dashboard. Always call `finalize()` when finished.

Optional open options: `{ cwd?, suiteTitle? }` (see `MervExplicitLocalReportOptions`).

### Screenshot with Playwright page (optional)

Still only **`merv-client`** — bind page from `playwright` / `@playwright/test` if you already use a browser in the script:

```ts
import { chromium } from 'playwright';
import { AutomationTool, MervPlaywright, MervReport } from 'merv-client';

const browser = await chromium.launch();
const page = await browser.newPage();
MervPlaywright.setAutomationToolObject(AutomationTool.PLAYWRIGHT, page);

const report = await MervReport.open();
await report.createTest('UI check', 'Home title');
await page.goto('https://example.com');
await report.validation('Title', 'Example Domain', await page.title(), true);
await report.finalize();

MervPlaywright.clear();
await browser.close();
```

### Lower-level local assembly

```ts
import { MervExplicitLocalReport } from 'merv-client';

const run = MervExplicitLocalReport.open();
const shot = run.copyScreenshotFromFile('/tmp/checkout.png', 'checkout-step');
run.addTestCase({
  testcaseName: 'Checkout flow',
  status: 'PASSED',
  startTime: new Date().toISOString(),
  endTime: new Date().toISOString(),
  executionMachine: 'ci-runner-01',
  testSteps: [
    {
      teststepName: 'Confirm order',
      stepType: 'ASSERTION',
      status: 'PASSED',
      expected: 'Order confirmed',
      actual: 'Order confirmed',
      screenshots: shot ? [shot] : [],
    },
  ],
});
run.finalize();
```

---

## View reports

- Local: run **`merv show-report`** → http://127.0.0.1:6174/ (or open `{merv.report.folder}/index.html` via any static server)
- Server: results in the Merv App
